source.target_resolution: derive the called Boolean production function from the failing protected assertion/dependency trace; no repaired-head production may be read

observation_language.name: GENERIC_PRIMITIVE_ATTRIBUTE_PROJECTION_CLOSURE_V1
observation_language.projections: for the failing runtime argument x, enumerate one-step attributes returned by dir(x), excluding names that raise on getattr; retain only values of type None/bool/int/float/str/bytes or tuples composed solely of those primitive types
candidates: projection: f(getattr(x,a)) for every retained one-step attribute a
observation_language.generation_order: identity first, then attribute names in lexicographic order
admissibility: candidate changes the failing classifier result to the verifier-required Boolean label
candidate preserves the classifier result on every passing runtime argument captured from the same protected test family
candidate introduces no new exception on captured cases
candidate is genuinely distinct from identity on the residual
observation_language.selection: minimum projection depth, then lexicographic attribute path; extensionally equal candidates quotient before selection
forbidden: source line or target attribute supplied to the generator

repair_constructor.name: GUARDED_RECURSIVE_PROJECTION_V1
repair_constructor.form: for selected projection p and required Boolean label L: before existing classifier body, safely obtain p(x); if recursive call f(p(x)) equals L, return L; otherwise execute original body unchanged
repair_constructor.recursion_guard: only recurse when projected value is not identical to the original object; attribute lookup failure falls through
repair_constructor.candidate_count: exactly one repair for the selected minimal observation; no alternate edits after native outcome
repair_constructor.preservation: original body byte-for-byte retained after inserted guard

gates.observation: mechanically captured residual cases must yield a unique minimal behavioural observation class
gates.native_repair: selected generated repair passes both protected nodes twice and full tests/test_annotations.py with zero failures/errors
gates.withdrawal: exact frozen original production restores the original protected failure
gates.future: tox-dev/tox#4168 remains sealed; this experiment cannot promote G2 by itself

reuse.MSI: observation-language genesis principle: verifier residual licenses minimum generated observation refinement
reuse.consequential_quotient: extensionally equal projection observations are one class
reuse.AnyIO: class-relative selection and source-bound native withdrawal/restoration
